item.title: security: Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence observed threat actors using the agentic offensive security framework ARTEX to search GitHub for exposed OAuth application secrets. Compromised OAuth applications were then used to carry out authenticated actions inside affected organizations’ tenants.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that North Korean threat actors are increasingly using AI in their operations, with different levels of adoption across groups. The post describes how AI is being incorporated into attack chains to improve speed and efficiency.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
